identification: E. Graeme Robertson and Edith N. Craig, Early Houses of Northern Tasmania, Volumes I and II, Georgian House, Melbourne 1964, the original edition of 1,000 numbered copies signed by both authors; this is no. 615, signed in ink (blue Craig, black Robertson). Both volumes in pictorial dust jackets with rubbing and edge wear; a dealer/price sticker on the Vol I jacket front. Interior plates clean. The 1966 one-volume abridged edition is the cheap one; this is the full signed set.
